Features

When you create a move-out, the system proposes an existing meter reading result for all the billing-relevant registers allocated to
the installation for billing purposes. Ensure you have configured the system accordingly in Customizing under |)}*SAP Utilities
Device Management Meter Reading Basic Settings Define Control Parameters for Meter Reading Data Processing

e Ifthe system proposes a meter reading result then choose one of the following two options:
o If you adopt the meter reading result, the system adds the meter reading reason End to the result.
o If you change the meter reading result, a new result is created with the meter reading reason End.

e Ifthe system does not propose a meter reading result, you can have it estimate a result or enter one manually. In both
cases, the system creates a new result with the meter reading reason Move-in.

e If aresult is not created by your adopting/changing a proposed result, and if you do not enter one manually, the system
creates a service notification or service order for the register. For more information see service notifications and orders.

Automatic Estimation of Meter Reading Results During Move-Out

If a contract is terminated when a supply scenario is created or changed, you can have missing meter readings estimated
automatically when you create the move-out.

If you want to use this function, create an implementation for method STOP_CONTRACT of business add-in (BAdI)
ISU_IDE_DRGSCEN_GEN.

For more information, see the documentation for the BAdI.

If you want to use the function for automatically estimating missing meter readings during move-out in the master data generator,
adjust your master data templates as follows in Customizing for SAP Utilities under |)sCustomer Service » Master Data
Generator Define Master Data Template

Attribute ESTIMATE_MR (Master data generator: Estimate MR Results During Move-Out) must contain the value "X in all nodes
of the master data template category MOVE_OUT (Move-Out in Connection with CRM).

Move-Out Reversal

Use

You use this function to reverse the termination of a contract during move-out. In doing this, the move-out date is set back in the
contract. You require this function in the following instances:

e The move-out was mistakenly created with the wrong business partner or with the wrong contract.

e Achanged move-out date subsequently becomes known. In this case, the move-out must be recreated using the changed
move-out date after the move-out reversal is performed.

e The move-out only relates to some of the contracts of the business partner. In this case, the move-out must be recreated
for the contracts that are actually concerned after the move-out reversal is performed.
